what: The SGit Newsroom, imported from sgit.ai's built pages at the same paths. Written by admin/build/sync_newsroom.py; do not edit the imported files by hand.
sha256: sha256_source is the file as sgit.ai serves it. sha256 is the file as imported, with the site nav, the site footer, the agent-chip stamp and the index.md version line emptied, because chrome.py restamps those on every release. validate.js check 11 recomputes it for every file listed here.

source.subject: site v0.7.87: the newsroom has moved, phase one

text_overrides.why: The note said "nothing is sent anywhere", which is about the reading data and reads as wider than that once a top-up link exists, and it was written in a chatty register ("it never nags", "and that is all") on a page that now takes payment. It now says what is kept where, what can leave the browser and when, in plain terms and without absolutes.
The second sentence of the intro repeated what the top-up card directly below it says.

Removed at Dinis's request: a technical disclaimer under the payment button. The limit it states, that the return page cannot check the payment, is still published on /shipped/ and in the meter's security model.

The account page of the reading meter v1.4.0 no longer has a Start again button: it wiped the balance, the history and the personas in one tap, which is too much to leave next to Export. The way to clear what is kept is the browser's own.
Same change as personas-clear-data: the mitigation named a button that v1.4.0 does not have.
The component documentation lists the account view of v1.3.1. This site runs v1.4.0, and the page should say what a reader here sees.
The account page is written for sgit.ai, where the meter also runs on the docs, the vaults and the network. Here it is the newsroom's meter, and the sentence should name the place the reader is in.
The price table named sgit.ai's docs, vaults and network, which this site does not charge for. It now names the pages here that carry the 1p price, and the pages this site writes, which are free.

Issue 3 was posted on LinkedIn on 13 October 2026. Its source is sgit.ai's, which this site does not edit, so the link its linkedin: field would have rendered is added here, in the same words and markup as issues 1 and 2. Retire this rule when sgit.ai's issue 3 carries the link, or when the generator moves here.
The same link on issue 3's card in the list of issues, as issues 1 and 2 have it. Retire with issue-3-linkedin.

Since v0.12.99 the meter (sg-meter v1.5.0) charges by the share READ, measured by the reading strip, not by how far the page was scrolled (card 080, the owner's decision of 16 October 2026: 'Charge based on what you read, not based on what you scroll'). The sentence said scroll. Retire when sgit.ai's account page says the same.
